data.one_liner: Parse pubspec.yaml files with a type‑safe API and detailed error reporting.
data.what_it_does: Provides classes to read and write pubspec.yaml content, exposing hosted, git, and path dependencies as typed objects. Supports lenient parsing, preserves map spans, and can serialize back to a Map.
use_when: You need to validate or transform a pubspec.yaml in a tool or CI step
You are building a CLI that inspects package metadata
You want a robust, typed representation of pubspec fields for analysis
avoid_when: Parsing arbitrary YAML where a generic parser is sufficient
Runtime pubspec parsing in a production Flutter app where size matters
strengths: Typed API for all pubspec fields
Rich, precise error messages via checked_yaml
Supports latest Dart pubspec features (git tag_pattern, falseSecrets, hooks, platforms)
Lenient mode to ignore unknown keys
weaknesses: Specialized to pubspec files only, not a general YAML library
Adds another dependency if you already use a generic YAML parser

alternatives.name: yaml
alternatives.why_pick_it: A generic YAML parser that can read any YAML file, including pubspec.yaml, without extra package overhead
